description: Check whether a Bitcoin/Ordinals inscription mint can be funded SAFELY before anything is signed. An inscription is an ordinary sat in an ordinary UTXO, so naive coin selection will spend a six-figure inscription as fee-paying change and burn it to the miner, with no revert. This excludes inscription-bearing, rune-bearing and unproven outpoints BEFORE selection, prices the commit output (which must fund the reveal exactly, because the reveal has no other input), and refuses a payload too heavy to relay. Reports how many UTXOs were withheld, so a wallet that looks funded but is locked in inscriptions explains itself. Read-only.

annotatedUtxos.description: UTXOs annotated with hasInscription/hasRune. Anything unproven is treated as unspendable.

contentBytes.description: Inscription payload size. Witness data, so charged at a quarter weight.

satIndexAvailable.description: Whether a sat index backs the annotation. Without it rare sats cannot be excluded and the result says so.

satVb.description: Target fee rate in sat/vB. Use bitcoin_mint_fee_rate for the live marginal rate.
